subject: Subprocessor roster update — request to confirm dataflow mappings for AtlasPayments
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Subprocessor roster update — request to confirm dataflow mappings for AtlasPayments

Samir,

I wanted to flag a routine update to Redwood's subprocessor roster that impacts a small set of networking and analytics providers. We completed our quarterly roster refresh and attached the CSV with the new additions and changes (subprocessors_roster_v2.csv).

Action requested: could you and/or your security team review the list and confirm whether any of the newly listed subprocessors require additional contractual terms or an updated dataflow diagram for AtlasPayments' compliance review? Specifically, we've noted a new edge-logging proxy provider and an analytics vendor that will process aggregated usage metrics.

I've included Priya (legal) and Laura (customer success) to help triage — Priya can advise on contractual impacts, and Laura will coordinate evidence if you need it for audit.

Attachments:
- subprocessors_roster_v2.csv (CSV, ~28 KB)
- link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/AtlasPayments/subprocessors_roster_v2.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlaspayments.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlaspayments.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 13:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Subprocessor roster update — request to confirm dataflow mappings for AtlasPayments

Markus,

Thanks for the heads up and for the CSV. Quick questions from our side after a first pass:
- Which of the new entries have access to plaintext payloads versus aggregated/telemetry-only data?
- For the analytics vendor, can you confirm they only receive de-identified, aggregated metrics? Our security policy requires that any vendor processing PII be covered under our DPA addendum.

Procurement is copied for contract follow-up. If you can point us to a dataflow diagram (or a one-page mapping) that shows the flow for AtlasPayments traffic, that would speed review.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, Security & Privacy
AtlasPayments

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subprocessor roster update — request to confirm dataflow mappings for AtlasPayments

Samir — appreciated. Short answers below, and I've attached an updated diagram that highlights processing categories per vendor.

- Edge-logging proxy: processes connection metadata (IP, routing metadata) and stores logs for 7 days; it does not persist user-provided content. It is used for routing analytics and incident diagnosis.
- Analytics vendor: receives only aggregated telemetry derived from tokenized usage counts; no customer payloads or raw text are shared.

Attached: redwood_dataflow_diagram_v3.pdf (high-level flows with vendor labels). Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/AtlasPayments/dataflow_diagram_v3.pdf

If procurement needs specific contractual language (e.g., DPA addendum), Priya can propose the minimal changes we typically accept for telemetry-only processors.

Would you like a short 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the diagram and records? Laura can set it up.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlaspayments.com>, procurement@atlaspayments.com
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subprocessor roster update — request to confirm dataflow mappings for AtlasPayments

Hi Samir / Procurement team —

Following up to offer the supporting evidence you might need for your audit intake:
- We can provide vendor SOC attestation summaries and encryption-in-transit screenshots for the edge provider.
- For the analytics vendor, we have a short attestation letter stating processing is limited to de-identified aggregates (sample provided on request).

If procurement prefers, we can prepare a single zipped evidence bundle (attachments: SOC_summary_edge_provider.pdf, analytics_attestation_sample.pdf). Please confirm the preferred upload method (secure link or sftp) and the contact for document receipt.

Next steps suggested:
1) Procurement confirms whether the telemetry-only classification is sufficient.
2) If yes, we provide the evidence bundle and mark the roster update as accepted.
3) If no, Priya will propose DPA addendum language.

Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0143
